title: Habit tracker: before I scaffold
summary: Kick off a project: stack, data, accounts, tooling and deploy in one form, my recommendations pre-selected.
description: The repo is empty, so a few choices before I generate anything. I pre-selected what fits what you told me: a small app for you and a few friends, cheap to run. Accept a page in one tap or change anything.

fields.label: Front end
fields.help: A habit tracker is mostly client-side; its API fits in one small server.

options.label: Vite + React
options.description: A static SPA: cheapest to host, fastest dev loop

options.label: Next.js
options.description: Server rendering and API routes in one app

options.label: SvelteKit
options.description: Less code per screen, smaller bundles

options.label: Astro + islands
options.description: Best when most pages are content

options.label: PocketBase
options.description: Auth, database and admin UI in one binary

options.label: Supabase
options.description: Hosted Postgres + auth, generous free tier

fields.label: Database
fields.help: SQLite holds this app's data for years; moving to Postgres later is a driver swap with the ORM I'd use (Drizzle).

options.label: SQLite
options.description: One file, backed up with the app

fields.label: What goes in the first version?

options.label: Share a habit with friends
options.description: They see your streak, you see theirs

fields.label: Works offline (installable PWA, syncs when back online)

options.label: End-to-end tests of the main flows (Playwright)
Fly.io
options.description: One container plus a volume for SQLite, about $2/month

fields.label: How far should I take the first pass?
fields.help: 1 = a clickable skeleton · 3 = the features above, working, plain looks · 5 = polished and deployed
